basis: Azenta, Inc. reported consolidated GAAP revenue of $154,317,000 for fiscal Q1 2024, ended December 31, 2023, versus $178,366,000 a year earlier. Both periods include B Medical Systems. The 13.483% decline clears the $169,447,700 cutoff. November 13 is the earliest verified quarter-specific warning I found, but management described the overall decline as “mid-teens” without a numeric endpoint. February 7 is the verified actual-results date. The available primary records do not establish whether management gave a qualifying numeric bound during an earlier public presentation or Q&A.

coverage.detail: August 8, preceding earnings cycle. The $155–173 million quarterly revenue range applied to fiscal Q4 2023, ended September 30. The $648–665 million range covered all of fiscal 2023.
August 15, UBS. The recovered deck labels the $155–173 million range as August guidance for Q4 FY2023. Its Q1 FY2023 revenue column is historical.
September 12, Baird. The guidance table again identifies $155–173 million as the September-quarter range.
September 13, Morgan Stanley. The fiscal 2023 revenue estimate uses the August annual guidance midpoint. I found no December-quarter consolidated revenue endpoint in the deck.
September 26. Azenta expressly reaffirmed fourth-quarter fiscal 2023 guidance.

November 13, immediately preceding earnings release. The $696–718 million total revenue range and 5–8% organic growth outlook both cover full-year fiscal 2024. Neither supplies a December-quarter ceiling.
November 13, companion exhibit. It covers governance changes and share repurchases. It supplies no quarterly revenue bound.

November 13, complete 24-page call deck. Slide 16 says “Overall, Q1 expected to decline mid-teens year-over-year.” The approximately 75% decline applies solely to B Medical. Management described combined growth in the other two businesses as low single digits. These statements supply no explicit consolidated numeric endpoint.

Archived earnings-call rescue. The issuer’s fiscal 2023 results table links the Q4 release, deck and filing. I could not retrieve official call audio or a transcript there. The November 13 call transcript at https://www.marketbeat.com/earnings/reports/2023-11-13-brooks-automation-inc-stock-1/ independently reproduces the same mid-teens wording in management’s prepared remarks.

Stephens. Azenta’s November 10 notice scheduled a public presentation for November 16 at 11 a.m. Central and promised a replay through https://investors.azenta.com/events. I could not recover it. The host page at https://www.stephens.com/events/stephens-annual-investment-conference and its linked agenda establish the event but did not yield Azenta’s remarks.

November 29, Evercore. The host agenda lists Azenta’s CFO and head of IR under “1x1 Meetings Only.” Azenta’s notice confirms the format at https://investors.azenta.com/2023-11-21-Azenta-to-Participate-in-the-6th-Annual-Evercore-ISI-HealthCONx-Conference. Neither document identifies a public Azenta presentation.

January 11, J.P. Morgan. The issuer event page dates the presentation to 7:30 a.m. Pacific. The full deck at https://investors.azenta.com/download/Azenta-Investor_Overview_for_JPM_1.8.24_5PM.pdf labels its fiscal 2024 guidance as historical. The issuer-linked host replay at https://jpmorgan.metameetings.net/events/healthcare24/sessions/49707-azenta/webcast?gpu_only=true&kiosk=true returned a cache miss. Spoken remarks remain unverified.

January 18, Needham. Recovered the full issuer deck after the IR archive download returned 404. Its $696–718 million range is expressly the November 13 full-year guidance. I found no December-quarter consolidated bound. The webcast-host lookup at https://wsw.com/webcast/needham134/azta/ yielded no accessible recording, and the secondary transcript lookup at https://www.gurufocus.com/stock/AZTA/transcripts/2187158 returned a cache miss.
January 31. The exhibit recasts fiscal 2022 and 2023 historical segment information. Its $178 million December-quarter total, including $42 million from B Medical, is for December 2022.

February 7 actuals. The consolidated statements of operations, in thousands, report products of 53,393 and services of 100,924, totaling 154,317 versus 178,366. The separate organic decline of 15% uses a different basis.

publication_date_evidence: Azenta’s November 13 release announced the public earnings call for 4:30 p.m. Eastern that day. Its dated slide 16 establishes the qualitative warning. The actual-results exhibit is dated February 7, 2024, and EDGAR records same-day acceptance at 16:21:16 at https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/933974/000155837024000860/0001558370-24-000860-index.htm. Those dates are verified. The earliest qualifying numeric disclosure remains unresolved.
